ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The feasible region is determined by x≥0, y≥0, x+2y≤4, and is a triangular region, with vertices (0,0), (4,0), and (0,2). Regard z=(y+2)/(x-1) as the slope of the line connecting the fixed point P=(1,-2) and the moving point Q=(x,y) in the feasible region, where when x=1 the expression is meaningless and needs to be excluded. Divide the triangle into left and right parts according to the line x=1. If x<1, then x-1<0, while y+2>0, so z<0. At this time the maximum value of the slope, that is, the negative value closest to 0, is attained at Q=(0,0), z=(0+2)/(0-1)=-2; when Q approaches x=1 from the left side, the denominator approaches 0^-, and z approaches -∞, so the left side gives (-∞,-2]. If x>1, then x-1>0, and y+2>0, so z>0. At this time the minimum positive slope corresponds to drawing a ray from P=(1,-2) that just touches the lower right endpoint Q=(4,0) of the triangle, obtaining z=(0+2)/(4-1)=2/3; when Q approaches x=1 from the right side, the denominator approaches 0^+, and z approaches +∞, so the right side gives [2/3,+∞). Combining the two parts obtains the range of values of z.

method.method_draft: Use a geometric slope interpretation. Read the feasible set from the problem as the triangle defined by x≥0, y≥0, x+2y≤4, with vertices (0,0), (4,0), (0,2). Observe that z=(y+2)/(x-1) is the slope of the line through the fixed point P=(1,-2) and the variable point Q=(x,y) in this triangle, excluding x=1. Split the triangle by the vertical line x=1. For points with x<1, the denominator is negative and y+2>0, so slopes are negative; the largest possible negative slope occurs at Q=(0,0), giving z=-2, while slopes tend to -∞ as Q approaches x=1 from the left. Thus the left part gives (-∞,-2]. For points with x>1, slopes are positive; the smallest positive slope occurs along the ray from P tangent to the triangle at Q=(4,0), giving z=2/3, while slopes tend to +∞ as Q approaches x=1 from the right. Thus the right part gives [2/3,+∞). Combine the two intervals.

method.method_draft: Use direct algebra and interval union by fixing x. From the constraints, 0≤x≤4 and for each x, 0≤y≤(4−x)/2. Since y+2>0, split by the sign of x−1. For 0≤x<1, z is negative and for fixed x decreases as y increases; in particular choosing y=0 already gives z=2/(x−1), whose values as x runs over [0,1) are (-∞,-2]. Other allowed y values only make z more negative and stay inside this same interval, so the left side contributes (-∞,-2]. For 1<x≤4, z is positive and choosing y=0 gives z=2/(x−1), whose values as x runs over (1,4] are [2/3,+∞). Other allowed y values only increase z and remain in this positive interval. Therefore the full range is (-∞,-2]∪[2/3,+∞).
method.CoT_raw: 由约束 x+2y-4≤0，x≥0，y≥0，可得 0≤x≤4，且对每个固定的 x，有 0≤y≤(4-x)/2。因为 z=(y+2)/(x-1)，且 y+2>0，同时 x=1 时分母为 0，表达式无意义，所以分 x<1 与 x>1 讨论。若 0≤x<1，则 x-1<0，z<0。固定 x 时，y 增大，分子 y+2 增大而分母为负，所以 z 减小；取 y=0 时 z=2/(x-1)。当 x 在 [0,1) 上变化时，2/(x-1) 的取值为 (-∞,-2]，其他允许的 y 只会使 z 更小，仍在 (-∞,-2] 内，因此负值部分为 (-∞,-2]。若 1<x≤4，则 x-1>0，z>0。固定 x 时，y 增大使 z 增大；取 y=0 时 z=2/(x-1)。当 x 在 (1,4] 上变化时，2/(x-1) 的取值为 [2/3,+∞)，其他允许的 y 只会使 z 增大，仍包含在该正区间内。因此 z 的全部取值范围为 (-∞,-2]∪[2/3,+∞)。
